gizmo.title: Mzere wa gulu
gizmo.description: Chinthu chooneka ngati mzere chogwiritsidwa ntchito mkati mwa mndandanda wa gulu, chokhala ndi mawu, ulalo, chizindikiro, ma tagi, ndi chithunzi chosankha.

advanced.title: Mphamvu ya mitundu
advanced.description: Sinthani kuwala kwa mitundu ya chithunzi wogwiritsa ntchito akaika chidwi.

advanced.title: Ma Tagi
advanced.description: Mndandanda wa ma tagi olekanitsidwa ndi koma.

advanced.title: Mtundu
advanced.description: Mtundu wogwiritsidwa ntchito pa chizindikiro ndi ma tagi.
